needed.evidence: A continuous, purpose-built sidewalk is present, but it is partially obstructed by parked vehicles, reducing its effective width and usability.
needed.suggestion: Relocate the on-street parking bays further from the curb or install a physical barrier to guarantee a clear, unobstructed pedestrian path.
